name: muse
description: Component specification plugin. Turns UI/design intent into unambiguous, testable component specs — props, variants, per-state behavior, and accessibility criteria as testable propositions, gated before planning. Audits the spec, not the implementation; code-level accessibility scanning of the built component is not yet covered by ranger. Also sketches options before anything is specified (sketch) and carries a chosen option into a requirement (promote).
